newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand light to moderate. Seller interest light to moderate, Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1150 lbs few 68.25.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1350 lbs 109.00-111.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs couple lds 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 100.00-101.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1150 lbs few 110.00.
For the week - 39,000 Wk ago - 18,300 Yr ago - 33,100
Steers and heifers - Live basis; steady to 50 lower. Carcass basis - weak to 1.00 lower.
Wk to Date- 35,700 Week Ago - 19,300 Year Ago - 33,100
